name: sortable-list
title: Sortable List
description: Reorderable rows on ItemGroup/Item via use-drag-reorder — pointer drag with drop indicators, keyboard move mode, a lossless Move menu, and server-refusable moves. Controlled; the host owns the order.

meta.whenToUse: User-orderable single lists — settings sections, pipeline stages, ordered taxonomies — where the host persists (and may refuse) the order.
meta.whenNotToUse: Cross-container card movement (board), selectable data tables (DataList — never mix selection with reordering), or read-only lists (ItemGroup).
